verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent building blocks. Drata supports custom connections (a Create Custom Connection endpoint) and custom workflows to automate evidence collection, and it exposes controls and monitoring tests through list endpoints. Nothing documents creating custom frameworks or custom controls, or attaching user-defined tests and evidence requirements to them. Missing for 10: documented custom framework creation, custom control creation, user-defined test logic tied to controls, configurable evidence requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
